description: This file defines a class XAIModelInfo that provides utility methods for interacting with an external AI service API, including environment validation, model retrieval, and API configuration.

classes.name: XAIModelInfo
classes.description: A class extending BaseLLMModelInfo providing methods for configuring environment, retrieving models, and API details specific to the 'XAI' provider.

methods.name: Optional[ProviderSpecificModelInfo] get_provider_info( self, model: str, )
methods.description: Returns provider-specific information such as support for web search.

methods.name: dict validate_environment( self, headers: dict, model: str, messages: List[AllMessageValues], optional_params: dict, litellm_params: dict, api_key: Optional[str] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None, )
methods.description: Prepares and validates headers and parameters for API environment, setting authorization and content type.

methods.name: Optional[str] get_api_base(api_base: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Retrieves the API base URL, either from parameter, environment variable, or default.

methods.name: Optional[str] get_api_key(api_key: Optional[str] = None)
methods.description: Retrieves the API key, either from parameter or environment variable.

methods.name: Optional[str] get_base_model(model: str)
methods.description: Removes 'xai/' prefix from the model string to get the base model name.

methods.name: List[str] get_models( self, api_key: Optional[str] = None, api_base: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Fetches available models from the external API and formats them for use.
